hook.text: An Uber driver with a 4.3 rating earns 40% less than one with 4.8. Tenths of a point change lives.

buildup.text: Platform economies turned reputation into a number. Your score determines access to work and housing.

discovery.text: Airbnb hosts with African-American names get 16% fewer bookings. Bias hides inside 'objective' ratings.

twist.text: We escaped village gossip only to build global gossip systems with even less accountability.

climax.text: A bad review on Google can bankrupt a small business overnight—digital honor is economic survival.

punchline.text: Stars replaced whispers, but the power is the same.

quiz.question: What Airbnb study revealed racial bias in ratings and bookings?
